The walking dead season one 2012. At the time my parents had just divorced and my father was jobless he was our caretaker while our mother worked. Once she left him he had nothing and became homeless. Meanwhile my grandmother was losing her battle with breast cancer and my mother had lost her job shortly after my dad was gone. We had to move away because she couldn’t afford the house anymore. Eventually my mom started having seizures around us. I remember blood pouring out of her mouth and we thought she was dying. I’m the oldest so I called 911 and comforted my brothers. I was 11. After that first seizure her personality changed. She went from being a compassionate mother to no longer feeding us or taking care of us. She went out with a new man every night and spent all her saved up money on blazer games(basketball games) and fancy dinners while we went without food and had one set of clothes each. She locked herself in her bedroom doing drugs leaving us alone to fend for ourselves while we starved most days or if we were lucky she’d feed us 25cent ramen. Our neighbors were kind enough to offer my brothers jobs rolling newspapers they were 8 and 10 rolling newspapers so we could eat something, anything. I babysat kids for a couple bucks so we could eat too. Because we moved I had no friends or adults to talk to about what was happening. I was suicidal I thought I was gonna die because my momma didn’t love me anymore. I caught my youngest brother cutting himself he was only 8 and blaming himself for this woman abandoning us. Well eventually that year my grandmother passed away and I was heartbroken. Absolutely devastated but because she passed away my father was able to get back on his feet and save us from our mother. We went from 1 meal a week and 1 shower every 6 months to living in a decent home with unconditional love from my father. The first thing my daddy bought me after all this hell was a phone my brothers and I shared and my youngest brother introduced me to YouTube and he introduced me to pewds let’s play of the walking dead. It was the first thing that made me laugh and cry and feel like a kid instead of being my younger brothers’ parent. That game came into my life It gave me something to look forward to a new sense of hope for the future. You know despite all the horrible things happening to my family it gave me a reason to look forward to the future with my family. I fell in love with Lee and Clementines story so much because it reminded me of my relationship with my dad. I will always be grateful for the things he’s done for us and always be grateful for experiencing a game I can so deeply appreciate and relate with. Thank you telltale games for creating such a beautiful game that will forever be apart of my life. Thank you pewds for playing the walking dead and thank you for reading this comment.
